items.title: Wake up and talk to Grandma Tuff
items.detail: She's in the kitchen. Pick **Yes** twice to skip the long intro.

items.title: Get the wooden spoon (starter weapon)
items.detail: In the chest behind the house. Equip it from the menu: `Gear → Main hand`.

items.title: Beat the Grumpy Scarecrow
items.detail: Weak to *fire*. Stay on the left side so his hay throws miss.

items.title: Save at the inn
items.detail: The innkeeper is upstairs. Saving is free.

items.title: Find the glow lamp
items.detail:
Inside the ring of mushrooms, first fork **left**.

![Route through the caves](img/sample-game/caves-map.svg)

items.title: Fix the rope bridge
items.detail:
You need 2 rope coils:

1. One on the ledge above the river.
2. One in the crate by the campfire.

items.title: Get the sky key from the pigeon
items.detail: The pigeon only lands if you stand still for 5 seconds.

items.title: Find the baker's rolling pin
items.detail:
Do this first: the reward (*Lucky Bread*) doubles EXP for the next chapter.

The pin is on the **roof of the well**. Climb the ladder near the fountain.

items.title: Build the Rainbow Raft
items.detail: Follow the walkthrough step by step. This item ticks itself when every step is done.

items.title: Get the cat down from the tree
items.detail: Needs the glow lamp from chapter 2.

items.title: Deliver letters for the mail frog
Pebble 4 · scarecrow field
items.detail: Gone after the scarecrow fight. Grab it **before** the boss.

guides.title: How this tracker works
guides.body:
This is a **pretend game** so you can try every part of the app. It gets replaced by real games.

## The three tabs

- **Next**: what to do this session. Pinned items come first, then the next things you haven't done.
- **Checklist**: everything, in sections and groups. Tap a group to open it.
- **Guides**: longer pages like this one, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

## Ticking things off

1. Tap the box on the left to tick an item.
2. Tap the title to see more (when there's an arrow).
3. Tap the pin to put an item at the top of **Next**.

Counters (like *Defeat 50 practice slimes*) have **−** and **+** buttons, or tap the number to type it.

## Walkthroughs

Open [Build the Rainbow Raft](guide:rainbow-raft) and tap **Follow guide**: one step per screen, big text, and the screen stays on.

## Backups

Progress lives on this device only. Go to **Settings → Export backup** now and then.

> Tip: links can jump between guides, like the [boss cheat sheet](guide:boss-cheatsheet).

guides.title: Build the Rainbow Raft
guides.intro: Four parts, all in Pebble Village. Takes about **10 minutes**. You need the glow lamp from chapter 2 for the last part.

steps.title: Part 1: First log
steps.text:
Walk behind the well and press `A` on the shiny log.

If it's not there, it spawned in one of the other spots below.
steps.alt: Map of the village with the log marked north of the well
options: On the dock, under the fishing net

steps.title: Part 2: Rope
steps.text: Open the crate at the end of the dock. Take the **rope**, leave the fish.

steps.title: Part 3: Sail
steps.text:
Ask Grandma for an old bed sheet. Pick:

1. *"I'm building a raft."*
2. *"It's for science."*

steps.title: Part 4: Rainbow paint
steps.text: Hold up the glow lamp (`ZR`) next to the mural until the colours drip into your bucket. Then go back to the dock and build the raft.

guides.title: Mossy Caves: full route
guides.body:
The caves are dark until you have the **glow lamp**. Follow these steps in order.

![Route through the caves: start, lamp, bridge, golem](img/sample-game/caves-map.svg)

## Route

1. Enter from the village side and go **left** at the first fork.
2. Pick up the glow lamp from the mushroom ring.
   - Hold `ZR` to raise it.
   - It runs out after about 2 minutes; refill at any blue crystal.
3. Cross the river on the stepping stones.
4. Fix the rope bridge (needs 2 rope coils, both in this area).
5. Rest at the campfire, then face the Moss Golem. See the [boss cheat sheet](guide:boss-cheatsheet).

## Shiny Pebbles in the caves

| # | Where | Needs |
|---|-------|:-----:|
| 6 | Under the first mushroom | – |
| 7 | Behind the waterfall | Glow lamp |
| 8 | On the broken bridge post | Rope |
| 9 | Inside the golem's arena (after the fight) | – |

*Missed one?* You can come back any time after chapter 2.

guides.title: Boss cheat sheet
guides.body:
| Boss | Chapter | Weak to | Level | Tip |
|:-----|:-------:|:--------|------:|-----|
| Grumpy Scarecrow | 1 | Fire | 3 | Stay on the left side |
| Moss Golem | 2 | Ice | 8 | Hit the glowing stone on its back |
| Thunder Duck | 3 | Rubber | 15 | Wear the ~~metal~~ **rubber** boots |

### General tips

- Heal when you drop below **30%**.
- Bosses can't be fought again, so grab each chapter's collectibles first.

guides.title: Fastest way to farm slimes
guides.body:
Practice slimes come back every time you leave the **Training Field**.

### Loop

1. Enter the field from the south gate.
2. Defeat the 5 slimes near the fence.
3. Leave and come back. Repeat.

That's **5 slimes per loop**, about *40 seconds* each, so 50 slimes take roughly 7 minutes.

### Notes

- Equip the *Bouncy Charm* for one-hit kills.
  - Sold in the village shop for 200 coins.
  - Or found for free in chapter 2.
- Turn on fast battles: `Options → Battle → Fast`.

More made-up slime facts: https://example.com/slimes
